definitions.explanation: A written or spoken statement declaring how one's property and affairs should be handled after death, or final words left for the living.

examples.japanese: {遺言|ゆいごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{遺言|ゆいごん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{土地|とち}→土地：02226_tochi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{孫|まご}→孫：03731_mago⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}した→残す：01975_nokosu⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather left the land to his grandchild in his will.

examples.japanese: {遺言|ゆいごん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧をめぐって⟦{親族|しんぞく}→親族：14199_shinzoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{争|あらそ}い→争い：09992_arasoi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{起|お}きた→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
examples.english: A dispute arose among the relatives over the contents of the will.

notes:
FORMS:
{遺|ゆい} (leave behind) + {言|ごん} (words) = words left behind.

PRONUNCIATION:
Also read as いごん, especially in legal contexts. The reading ゆいごん is standard in everyday use.

COMPOUNDS:
- {遺言|ゆいごん}⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧: written will, testament document
- {遺言|ゆいごん}{状|じょう}: letter of testament
- {遺言|ゆいごん}⟦{執行|しっこう}→執行：18996_shikkou⟧⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧: executor of a will

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {遺言|ゆいごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write a will
- {遺言|ゆいごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave a will
- {遺言|ゆいごん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{従|したが}う→従う：02059_shitagau⟧: to follow the will
- {遺言|ゆいごん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{公開|こうかい}→公開：11665_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to disclose the will
